Studio lab

One take.
A whole feed.

  1. Bring raw footage.Recorded sessions, fresh captures, anything on disk. Files stay local until publishing day.
  2. Let the scorer dig.Every beat earns a hype rating, a punchy headline and subtitles timed per word.
  3. Ship it tall.Vertical export, three caption looks, sized for each short-form feed.

Each upload wears the PostingGTA stamp, while every play points back toward $POSTING. Attention is the whole game, so the scoreboard stays public and the community keeps receipts.

MarketStudioRoadmap

PostingGTA stays an independent fan build. It has no link with any studio or publisher behind a game it mentions, and their marks stay theirs. $POSTING behaves as a speculative meme token with zero promised return. Market numbers arrive from public third-party feeds and can be wrong or slow.
